newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Rio state finalizes minimum price for gas firms.
newsitem.headline: Rio state finalizes minimum price for gas firms.

text.p: Rio de Janeiro state government has finalized the minimum price for the privatization of its gas firm Companhia Estadual de Gas (CEG) and piped gas distributor Riogas at 564 million reais (US$527.1 million).

The minimum price for CEG's total share capital has been set at 423 million reais ($395.3 million) and the base price for 100 percent of Riogas was fixed at 141 million reais ($131.8 million), the state finance department said in a statement.
Earlier, a state government official had said the minimum price for both companies amounted to 560 million reais ($523.4 million).

The statement said the state government expected the auction to achieve a premium of more than 30 percent on the minimum price given that 19 mostly foreign companies had shown interest in buying the gas firms.
Under the bid specifications published Friday, the state government will sell off voting shares in CEG worth 65.41 percent of total capital and 58.87 percent of voting capital.

Employees will be able to buy 8.18 percent of CEG voting shares at a discount of 30 percent on the minimum price, while the remaining 57.23 percent will be sold at auction with a minimum price of 252.46 million reais ($235.9 million).
